correction.text: the Western and Eastern Aden Protectorates, c. 285,000 km2

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: the full protectorate, dated by Cliopatria (its Kingdom of Great Britain shape grows by 1,407 cells in 1890); the page does not date the later treaties (confidence 1). The page gives 'The Western Protectorate (c. 55,000 km2)' and 'The Eastern Protectorate (c. 230,000 km2)', 285,000 km2 against 303,800 km2 of cells (ratio 1.07, fine). It 'extended well east of Aden to Hadhramaut'; the Aden Settlement itself is a British possession (united-kingdom ledger 1839), not part of it.

sources.title: Aden Protectorate - Wikipedia
sources.note: Aden Protectorate: Aden conquered January 1839, initial treaty 1872, formal treaty with the Mahra 1886, Western c. 55,000 and Eastern c. 230,000 km2, federations 1959 and 1963, British leaving November 1967; no infobox area.

notes: Written from one page (Aden Protectorate), a protectorate Cliopatria lacks that the united-kingdom dossier needs as a counterpart. Cliopatria draws the hinterland inside its Kingdom of Great Britain row from 1890 to 1968 as direct land; the united-kingdom dossier takes it out and records the relation as vassal events. Typed colony (a tint of the British metropole). Dates the page does not give: the protectorate's formal declaration in the 1890s, the later treaties, the end day (30 November 1967 is not on the page), and the capital. Perim, Kamaran and the Kuria Muria Islands are named on the page as administered from Aden but outside the protectorate and are not drawn. The Mahra sultanate also reaches into present-day Oman (Dhofar), which Cliopatria's shape clips at lon 53.1. Names the gazetteer lacks: Socotra (used as an 80 km radius at 53.9 E 12.5 N). The page also gives the Federation of Arab Emirates of the South (six states, accord of 11 February 1959) and the Federation of South Arabia (Aden Colony joined on 18 January 1963); no border moved and neither has a dossier, so they are not ledger events. REVIEW eu-11-l (2026-10-25): vassal_start/vassal_end with united-kingdom added to mirror that dossier's events.
